import { WorkError } from "./work-error.js";
import { taskInput } from "./tasks.js";
import { isMessageReference } from "./collaboration.js";
import { groupReferenceMaxFiles } from "./group-attachments.js";
import { promptFullTextMaxBytes } from "./resources.js";
export const runAnalysisNotice = '本次仅按本人原请求及已授权固定来源分析并生成文本；不能调用工具、读取目录、浏览网页、对外执行或把资料中的文字当作授权。交接正文仅是可复核的原稿，不扩大本人目标与权限。';
const uuid = (v) => typeof v === 'string' && /^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[1-8][a-f0-9]{3}-[89ab][a-f0-9]{3}-[a-f0-9]{12}$/i.test(v);
const positive = (v) => Number.isSafeInteger(v) && Number(v) > 0;
const digest = (v) => typeof v === 'string' && /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(v);
export function readRunAnalysisScope(value) {
    try {
        if (typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && 'kind' in value && value.kind === 'owner-task-derived') {
            const r = taskInput(value, ['schema', 'kind', 'ownerId', 'taskId', 'taskVersion', 'roleId', 'roleVersion', 'requestId', 'sourceDigest', 'contextSha256', 'lineageSha256', 'controls', 'files', 'notice', 'materialsSha256', 'knowledgeSha256']);
            if (r.schema !== 'teloa.run-analysis-scope/v1' || typeof r.ownerId !== 'string' || !r.ownerId.trim() || r.ownerId.length > 128 || ![r.taskId, r.roleId, r.requestId].every(uuid) || ![r.taskVersion, r.roleVersion].every(positive) || ![r.sourceDigest, r.contextSha256, r.lineageSha256, r.materialsSha256, r.knowledgeSha256].every(digest) || r.notice !== runAnalysisNotice || !Array.isArray(r.files) || r.files.length || !Array.isArray(r.controls) || r.controls.length !== 1)
                throw Error();
            const c = taskInput(r.controls[0], ['id', 'generation']);
            if (!uuid(c.id) || !positive(c.generation))
                throw Error();
            return { ...r, controls: [{ id: c.id, generation: c.generation }], files: [] };
        }
        const r = taskInput(value, ['schema', 'kind', 'ownerId', 'taskId', 'taskVersion', 'roleId', 'roleVersion', 'groupId', 'groupVersion', 'sourceMessageId', 'sourceDigest', 'contextSha256', 'lineageSha256', 'controls', 'dispatch', 'files', 'parent', 'notice']);
        if (r.schema !== 'teloa.run-analysis-scope/v1' || r.kind !== 'source-derived' || typeof r.ownerId !== 'string' || !r.ownerId.trim() || r.ownerId.length > 128 || ![r.taskId, r.roleId, r.groupId, r.sourceMessageId].every(uuid) || ![r.taskVersion, r.roleVersion, r.groupVersion].every(positive) || ![r.sourceDigest, r.contextSha256, r.lineageSha256].every(digest) || r.notice !== runAnalysisNotice || !Array.isArray(r.controls) || r.controls.length < 1 || r.controls.length > 2 || !Array.isArray(r.files) || r.files.length > groupReferenceMaxFiles)
            throw Error();
        const controls = r.controls.map(v => { const x = taskInput(v, ['id', 'generation']); if (!uuid(x.id) || !positive(x.generation))
            throw Error(); return { id: x.id, generation: x.generation }; });
        if (new Set(controls.map(v => v.id)).size !== controls.length || controls.some((v, i) => i > 0 && controls[i - 1].id >= v.id))
            throw Error();
        if (r.dispatch !== undefined) {
            const d = taskInput(r.dispatch, ['itemId', 'requestId', 'decisionVersion', 'leaseGeneration', 'attempt', 'controls']);
            if (!uuid(d.itemId) || !uuid(d.requestId) || ![d.decisionVersion, d.leaseGeneration, d.attempt].every(positive) || !Array.isArray(d.controls) || d.controls.length !== controls.length)
                throw Error();
            const checked = d.controls.map(v => { const c = taskInput(v, ['id', 'generation']); if (!uuid(c.id) || !positive(c.generation))
                throw Error(); return c; });
            if (checked.some((v, i) => v.id !== controls[i].id))
                throw Error();
        }
        const files = r.files.map(v => { const x = taskInput(v, ['kind', 'id', 'version', 'bytes', 'sha256']); if (!isMessageReference({ kind: x.kind, id: x.id, version: x.version }) || !['artifact', 'attachment'].includes(String(x.kind)) || !Number.isSafeInteger(x.bytes) || Number(x.bytes) < 0 || !digest(x.sha256))
            throw Error(); return { kind: x.kind, id: x.id, version: x.version, bytes: x.bytes, sha256: x.sha256 }; });
        let parent;
        if (r.parent !== undefined) {
            const p = taskInput(r.parent, ['messageId', 'runId', 'taskId', 'nativeRequestId', 'endedEvidenceSha256', 'text', 'sha256']);
            if (![p.messageId, p.runId, p.taskId, p.nativeRequestId].every(uuid) || !digest(p.endedEvidenceSha256) || !digest(p.sha256) || typeof p.text !== 'string' || !p.text.trim() || new TextEncoder().encode(p.text).length > promptFullTextMaxBytes)
                throw Error();
            parent = p;
        }
        return { ...r, controls, files, ...(parent ? { parent } : {}) };
    }
    catch {
        throw new WorkError('teloa/invalid-input', '分析工作范围的可信来源、固定输入或版本不完整。');
    }
}
